answer: Re-attestations are stored in echo and karst lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the ember graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 895 impostors cost 814 times the honest price and take 8 times as long to clear.
